description: This file is a shell script used to run tests on git cherry-pick functionality, particularly testing the --ff (fast-forward) option and related scenarios. It defines test cases, setup commands, and assertions to verify correct behavior of cherry-pick operations in a git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs the given commands, and checks for successful execution.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to ensure distinct commit timestamps.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Sets up or outputs object ID cache for testing purposes, reading input data.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expected to fail, asserting that it indeed fails.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Checks differences between commits or trees, possibly with options like --exit-code.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares revisions to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, performing any necessary cleanup.
